en-US.author: Hong Minhee
en-US.description: Converts mixed-script Korean text into hangul-only text
en-US.longDescription: Gukhanmun converts Korean text written in mixed script, with hanja characters interleaved with hangul, into hangul-only text. It provides a Rust library and command-line tool with support for plain text, HTML, and Markdown formats.
en-US.name: Gukhanmun
en-US.releaseNotes:
Released on November 5, 2026.

### gukhanmun

  • Markdown conversion escapes source text through the re-exported adapter, so the Rust API no longer drops the escapes and character references in the input. \[[\#35](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/issues/35), [\#36](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/pull/36)\]
  • HTML and Markdown conversions now escape dictionary readings end to end through the re-exported adapters.  \[[GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/security/advisories/GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g)\]

### gukhanmun-cli

  • `--format text/markdown` now preserves escapes and character references in source text both before and after the Hongdown formatting pass. \[[\#35](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/issues/35), [\#36](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/pull/36)\]
  • `--format text/html` and `--format text/markdown` now escape dictionary readings.  \[[GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/security/advisories/GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g)\]

### gukhanmun-core

  • Marked annotation-derived text with the new `RenderedToken::Annotated` variant so that format writers serialize a dictionary reading as literal text instead of treating it as already-valid markup.  The variant is a breaking change for code that matches `RenderedToken` exhaustively; a `_ =>` arm still compiles but silently drops the text.  Upgrade *gukhanmun-core*, *gukhanmun-html*, and *gukhanmun-markdown* together. \[[GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/security/advisories/GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g)\]

### gukhanmun-html

  • Escaped dictionary readings and other annotation text when writing HTML, including quotes and a guarded first character, so a reading can no longer become an element or an attribute.  \[[GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/security/advisories/GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g)\]
  • Stopped treating `<script/>`, `<style/>`, and `<textarea/>` as self-closing so their contents stay raw text, matching browsers.  Text after a self-closed raw-text tag inside SVG or MathML is now left unconverted rather than risking conversion inside a script or style body. \[[GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/security/advisories/GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g)\]

### gukhanmun-markdown

  • Escaped source text when writing Markdown, so backslash escapes and character references consumed by the parser are restored instead of being re-emitted raw.  Interior `<`, `&`, `[`, `]`, `` ` ``, `*`, `_`, `~`, `|`, and `\` can no longer reform HTML, links, images, emphasis, code spans, or tables, and line-start characters can no longer start a heading, list, block quote, or definition list after conversion.  Code blocks, autolinks, and HTML blocks remain untouched.  Literal `&` and `<` in prose now appear as `&` and `<` in Markdown output; the rendered text is unchanged. \[[\#35](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/issues/35), [\#36](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/pull/36)\]
  • Encoded dictionary readings as literal Markdown text, with U+200B separators that stop GFM from forming an autolink across a reading, so annotation text can no longer form links, emphasis, code spans, tables, or raw HTML. \[[GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/security/advisories/GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g)\]

### gukhanmun-napi

  • HTML and Markdown output escapes dictionary readings. \[[GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g](https://github.com/dahlia/gukhanmun/security/advisories/GHSA-j87h-8h88-wm6g)\]
